title: Generic C1 Future Inextendibility Near Rotating Subextremal Kerr Spacetimes
summary: For each fixed Kerr spacetime with mass M > 0 and rotation $`0\lt \mathfrak a\lt M`$, we prove that a dense G δ set of nearby smooth, complete two-ended vacuum data has a maximal globally hyperbolic development with no future C 1 extension. The neighborhood and genericity are defined in a weighted smooth topology, and ambient extensions may be nonvacuum.
family_title: Strong cosmic censorship near two-ended Kerr data

review.reason: Studies future inextendibility of nearby vacuum developments of subextremal Kerr spacetimes, with proofs.
